assets.brief: 80 BPM, E-flat major. An inviting lantern-lit castle gate, gentle wonder and a small mischievous smile. Celesta, lyrical clarinet, pizzicato violas and soft tambourine; spacious upper-register melody, no heavy war drums or brass march. Develop a complete original 120-second instrumental arc, with compatible opening and final two seconds for a seamless loop.

96 BPM, C Dorian. A lovable demon ruler straightening a crooked banner.
